messages:
Nora (marketing): Quick: we need a crisp battlecard for next webinar focusing on Competitive Messaging vs cloud APIs + infra vendors. Two short personas: FinOps (cost) & Platform (SLOs). 3 bullets each + 1-line rebuttal.
Ollie (growth): Lead with a dollar stat for FinOps. People want a number. Suggest A/B CTA: 'Estimate your token bill' vs 'See latency tail': run on landing.
Priya (product): Bench highlight: cached chat = $0.24/1k tokens; uncached ~ $0.62. Fallback improved success rate ~3x under simulated region stress. bench-bot uploaded CSV.
bench-bot: Bench report: https://redwood.internal/benches/1812 (internal)
Sam (sales): One-liner rebuttals: "Why not use cloud serverless?" -> "Serverless can spike costs and latency variance; Dedicated gives committed throughput and predictable invoices." And: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Portable model catalog + rollout controls." Keep them short.
Tara (content): I'll draft 3 slide hooks and 3 email subject lines per persona. Need final bullets by 2pm.
Nora (marketing): Draft bullets:```
FinOps / Cost:
- $0.24 / 1k tokens with prefix caching vs ~$0.62 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize reduces per-token surprises
- Rebuttal: "Surprise charges?" -> "Transparent token-level billing in Console."

Platform / Ops:
- SLA-backed Dedicated reduces 99p latency jitter ~3x in congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + model-variant fallback maintains success rate under pressure
- Rebuttal: "What about lock-in?" -> "Models and versions are portable; rollouts supported across variants."
```
Ollie (growth): I'll set up the AB CTA and track bench-click, demo-request, webinar-attend.
Sam (sales): I'll post two punchy outreach opens later today.
Nora (marketing): Action items: Priya confirm CSV link and fallback stat (by noon); Tara deliver hooks + subjects (by 2pm); Ollie wire AB test. I'll assemble the battlecard doc when done. :rocket:
